findings.claim: The missing-kmctl hint tells the user to run `kmctl plugin install`, a verb this release does not have (it lands in plugin-install-verb). This breaks the rule skills-name-only-shipped-verbs in .claude/rules/cli-version-floor.md, and a user who follows the hint gets "No such command".

test_plugin_has_one_sessionstart_hook reads only plugin/hooks/hooks.json. A hooks field added to plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, or a second hooks file it points at, would add a hook and the test would still pass.

The hook sets no timeout, so a hung `kmctl briefing` holds session start for Claude Code's default hook timeout. A short `timeout` on the hook entry would keep I1's "never blocks" true in that case too.
